result.summary: PASS. I compared the round-1 text with the revised file line by line: 136 changed lines, the conclusion region is unchanged, and every change was checked. AC2 over the whole file holds: «## Что нашли (проверено 2026-09-29)» (line 18) and «## Где искали» (line 317) are present; there is one conclusion region (lines 379-457) with nothing after it; every fact has a market mark («мир», «Казахстан/СНГ», [США], Россия inline); every price, competitor and market-size fact has a link; the vendor/[аналитик]/[СМИ]/[независимо] marks are now applied in sections 1-7, and the section 7 table has a «Тип источника» column. Round-1 fixes, each checked against the re-opened source: F1 fixed (lines 243-252). profit.kz: the 29% is Gartner analyst Arup Roy's global statistic and is now marked «мир» and [СМИ] and quoted verbatim. The «Agents Versus Humans» session is described as the article does (top managers and business owners in teams, two hours). Kaspi, Kazakhtelecom, Bank RBK and RG Brands appear only in panels, awards or partners, as the file now says; Almaty and 16.09.2026 are confirmed. F2 fixed: the section 2, 6 and 7 marks were checked. Jellyfish's own article is dated April 17, 2026, as the new text says. «Правительственные данные» matches trend.az («according to the Kazakh government»). «Данные министерства» matches kursiv («в министерстве искусственного интеллекта и цифрового развития»). F3 fixed (line 26): LangSmith base traces can be upgraded to extended traces (400 days) for a fee on any plan, and the Enterprise column states no retention period. F4 fixed (lines 48-50): the Helicone text now matches «security updates, new models, bug & performance fixes all keep shipping». F5 fixed (line 307): the claude.com post is dated May 11, 2026. F6 fixed (lines 229-231): the KPMG sampling wording is quoted verbatim from kapital.kz, and the 53% is correctly attributed to the region. F7 fixed: line 112 now names only the tools whose rows show hooks. I checked the newly named agent-virtual-office, whose README registers Claude Code hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse, SubagentStart/Stop, UserPromptSubmit, Stop and others). Lines 126-127 are now factual. F8 fixed (line 144): Pew is marked [США]; the page text confirms «U.S. adults». Also newly verified: the OpenAI prompt optimizer (Evals read-only on 31.10.2026, shutdown on 30.11.2026, no price), which could not be opened in round 1. No new issues found. Counters drift slightly (agent-virtual-office now shows 29 stars against 28 in the file); this is not a defect.
